headline: Approved minutes, contribution returns, retirement applications, and an actuarial services contract with USI actuaries.
summary: The board approved the July 20, 2026 meeting minutes, several returns of member contributions, and several retirement applications with one correction. The board also approved designating USI actuaries as technical advisor and recommending a contract with USI actuaries, and received presentations on contribution reconciliation and investment performance.
decisions: Approved the return of contributions as presented for Timothy J. Williams, Rachel Y. Lawler, Krista Y. Towne, Miguel A. Caez, Dillon J. Sommer, and Ellie Kim Murray.
Approved the retirement applications as presented, with a correction changing item 5.1 Kristian G. Carlson from Class B to Class A.

Approved designating USI actuaries as technical advisor to the Board and recommending the Chief Administrative Officer or designee execute a contract with USI actuaries, subject to review by the City Attorney's Office, for the City Staff Recommendation for Actuarial Services and DBA.
Approved awarding the actuary contract for USI actuaries to serve as technical advisor to the Board.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Board Member Parker, seconded by Board Member Olsen, to approve the July 20, 2026 Meeting Minutes. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Matson, to approve the return of contributions as presented. Motion passed unanimously.

Motion made by Board Member Dalla Mura, seconded by Board Member Kasti, to approve the retirement applications as presented with the following change: agenda item 5.1. Class A, not Class B, Kristian G. Carlson. Motion passed unanimously.
6.2. City Staff Recommendation for Actuarial Services and DBA Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Parker, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.

6.3. Award Actuary Contract To Serve As Technical Advisor To The Board Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Parker, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
